nav.label: Main navigation
role.organizer.desc: Sees open events, creates events, starts the kiosk and sees the overall result (counts and score) – no individual ratings, no export or PDF.
role.analyst.desc: Additionally sees all events and full results with individual ratings, edits events, exports CSV and PDF. Cannot delete events or ratings.
role.admin.desc: Everything: also deletes events and individual ratings, manages users and the appearance.
question.default.nps: How likely are you to recommend this event to others?
question.default.smiley: How did you like today's event?
error.title: Error {code}
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
error.session_expired: Session expired – please reload the page.
error.password_short: The password needs at least {n} characters.
setup.title: Set up Tapinion
setup.intro: Create the first administrator account. You can change the name, logo and colours afterwards under Settings.
setup.not_allowed: The first setup can only be done on the computer running Tapinion.
setup.not_allowed_hint: Open Tapinion there (http://localhost:…), or start the server with SETUP_TOKEN and open /setup?token=… – or create the first user with ADMIN_USER and ADMIN_PASSWORD.
login.title: Log in
login.intro: Results and administration are only available after logging in.
login.error_credentials: User name or password is wrong.
login.error_throttled: Too many failed attempts – please try again in a few minutes.
login.kiosks_intro: Start the rating screen for an open event directly on this device. The event's PIN is required.
account.title: Account
dashboard.delete_point_confirm: Delete the rating from {when}? This cannot be undone.
dashboard.aggregate_only: Your role shows the overall result only. Individual ratings, export and PDF are available to analysts and administrators.
reports.overview_intro: PDF overview of several events: totals, a table and the score per event, optionally with one page per event.
reports.preview: The report covers {events} event(s) with {responses} ratings ({first} to {last}).
reports.preview_empty: There are no events with ratings for this selection.
events.name: Name
events.create_hint: The PIN is needed to open and to leave the kiosk on a device. It can be viewed and changed later in the list.
events.start_confirm: Start the kiosk on this device? You will be logged out here; the device then only shows the rating screen until the PIN is entered. For another tablet, use the QR code instead.
events.qr_intro: Scan with the tablet (same network) to open the kiosk.
events.qr_pin_hint: The tablet asks for the event's PIN once.
events.relink_confirm: Create a new kiosk link? The old link and QR code stop working.
events.relinked: New kiosk link created – the old one no longer works.
events.error_pin: The kiosk PIN must have 4 to 8 digits.
events.error_mode_locked: The rating type cannot be changed once ratings exist.
kiosk.pin_title_unlock: Enter PIN to start the kiosk
kiosk.pin_title_exit: Enter PIN to leave the kiosk
kiosk.no_pin: No PIN is set for this event yet. Please set one under Events.
kiosk.locked: Kiosk locked – please enter the PIN.
settings.appearance_intro: Logo, name and colours for this installation – for example in the corporate design of your organisation or project. Used in the app, the kiosk and the PDF reports.
settings.logo_hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, at most 1 MB. A wide logo works best. PDF reports use PNG, JPG or WebP.
settings.show_open_events: Show open events on the login page (opening them requires the PIN)
settings.reset_confirm: Reset name, logo and colours to the defaults?
settings.error_color: “{value}” is not a colour in the form #RRGGBB.
settings.error_logo_size: The logo is larger than 1 MB.
settings.error_logo_type: The logo must be a PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG image.
users.error_username: User name: 3–64 characters, only letters, digits and . _ @ -
users.error_self: You cannot delete your own account.
users.error_last_admin: There must be at least one administrator.
report.question: Question: “{q}”
report.no_data: There are no ratings for this selection.
report.no_events: There are no events with ratings in the selected period.
report.score_note: NPS or satisfaction balance, each from −100 to +100.
wizard.welcome_intro: In five short steps Tapinion is ready: language, your account, your look, a first event – and the tablet for your guests.
wizard.account_intro: With this account you see all results and manage Tapinion. You can add more people with their own roles later.
wizard.account_hint: Keep the password safe – there is no reset by e-mail.
wizard.look_intro: Optional: your name, logo and colour appear in the app, on the kiosk and in the PDF reports.
wizard.look_later: You can change all of this any time under Settings.
wizard.event_intro: An event is one survey – for example a workshop, an open day or the canteen this week.
wizard.event_pin_hint: With this PIN the kiosk is opened and closed on the tablet. Write it down – you can also look it up later under Events.
wizard.tablet_intro: Scan this code with the tablet to open the kiosk for “{name}”.
wizard.howto_android: install the Tapinion app (from the download page), tap “Scan QR code”, enter the PIN – done.
wizard.howto_ipad: scan the code with the camera, enter the PIN, then Share → “Add to Home Screen” for full screen.
wizard.howto_here: in the Tapinion window click “Kiosk on this computer” – the rating screen opens full screen, e.g. on a laptop at the entrance. Or “Start kiosk here” below.
wizard.tablet_network: The tablet must be in the same Wi-Fi as this computer. If it cannot connect, allow Tapinion in the firewall (private networks).
wizard.tablet_later: You skipped the event. Under Events you can create one any time and show its QR code.
devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Every tablet, phone or computer that opened this kiosk. Any number of devices can collect for the same event, e.g. at several entrances. A device stays connected until it is switched off here or left with the PIN – even across restarts and internet outages.
devices.name: Device
devices.revoke_confirm: Switch off “{name}”? The device goes back to the PIN screen; its ratings remain.
devices.none: No device has opened this kiosk yet.
kiosk.offline_badge: offline – ratings are kept on this device
app.title: Tapinion for Android
app.intro: The app for tablets and smartphones: full-screen kiosk, finds this computer in the Wi-Fi by itself and keeps running offline.
app.step_download: On the tablet, tap “Download the app”.
app.step_unknown: Open the downloaded file and allow “install unknown apps” for the browser once.
app.step_connect: Open Tapinion: the app finds this computer in the Wi-Fi – tap it, choose the event, enter the PIN.
app.missing: This installation does not include the Android app. It is available on the download page.
app.qr_intro: Scan this code with the tablet's camera (same Wi-Fi), then download the app there.
app.link: Get the app straight from this computer
app.no_app_yet: No Tapinion app on the Android tablet yet?
